[LNAM.2.2.4] **Identifier / unit-symbol boundary.** A letter in [LNAM.2.2.1]'s legal set, such as `μ`
(`U+03BC GREEK SMALL LETTER MU`), may appear in an identifier. A character outside
it appears only in a type/unit position via the `TYPE_SYM` terminal ([LGRA] /
[LLEX]), never in an identifier: `µ` (`U+00B5 MICRO SIGN`), which is `XID` and not
`Allowed`, and `°` (`U+00B0 DEGREE SIGN`), which is not `XID`. In a unit position
the lexer folds `μ` to `µ` ([LLEX.12.2.1]).
